FileSink.Description: File logging enabled for production. Disable in development if console output is sufficient. File logging for production. Production-ready: enabled by default with 100MB rolling files. Adjust Path as needed for deployment. Log rotation: FileSizeLimitMb caps individual log files at 100MB; MaxFileCount=10 keeps at most 10 rotated files. For centralized log aggregation in production, configure a log shipper (Fluentd, Logstash, Vector) tailing /var/log/fishmmo/*.log and forwarding to an external store (Elasticsearch, Loki, Grafana Cloud). Alternatively, Docker logging drivers (fluentd, gelf, syslog) configured in docker-compose.yml bypass file logs entirely and send structured output straight to the aggregation endpoint.
FileSink._comment_path: Use a distinct path per process (LoginServer.log / WorldServer.log / SceneServer.log) when three GameServers share a host — a single shared file can contend under concurrent start.
